_comment: saltay-kokpit hook block. scripts/install.sh merges this into ~/.claude/settings.json and replaces __CLAUDE_HOME__ with the real path (e.g. /c/Users/you/.claude). All commands run under bash — on Windows that is Git Bash, which Claude Code already requires.

hooks.command: m=$(bash __CLAUDE_HOME__/hooks/hook-meta.sh); f=${m#*|}; if [[ -n "$f" && -f "$f" ]]; then mkdir -p .backups && cp "$f" ".backups/$(basename "$f").$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S).bak"; fi

m=$(bash __CLAUDE_HOME__/hooks/hook-meta.sh); f=${m#*|}; if [ -n "$f" ] && grep -qE '(password|secret|api_?key|access_?token|private_?key)\s*=\s*["\x27][^"\x27]{8,}' "$f" 2>/dev/null; then echo "⚠️  Possible hardcoded secret in $f" >&2; fi
